headline: Approved conditional employment offers to three police officer candidates, upon completing pre-employment requirements, and removed one candidate from the list.
summary: Members interviewed police officer candidates in executive session and took no votes there. After returning to public session, they removed Candidate #5 from the list. They also offered conditional employment to Candidates #6, 11, and 14.
decisions: Approved removing Candidate #5 from the police officer candidate list, passed unanimously.
Approved offering conditional employment to Candidates #6, 11, and 14 upon successful completion of pre-employment requirements, passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Ghio moved to REMOVE CANDIDATE #5 FROM THE LIST, seconded by Commissioner Kilbourne. VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED

Commissioner Ghio moved to OFFER CONDITIONAL EMPLOYMENT TO CANDIDATES # 6, 11, AND 14 UPON SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF ALL PRE-EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS, seconded by Commissioner Kilbourne. VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED

plain_text:
BOARD OF POLICE COMMISSIONERS 
SPECIAL MEETING 
                                                      AUGUST 31, 2026, AT 5:00 p.m. 
 
 
PRESENT:             ABSENT:  
Commissioner Paul Lemieux      Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Chairperson   
Commissioner Dean Kilbourne     Commissioner Terry Lewis          
Commissioner Rory Ghio 
Commissioner Gloria Sapp-Smith 
Council Member Sue Tyler               
 
 
 
1. CALL TO ORDER 
Commissioner Lemieux called the meeting to order at 5:05 P.M. 
 
 
2. TO CONVENE INTO EXECUTIVE SESSION TO INTERVIEW CANDIDATES FOR THE 
POSITION OF POLICE OFFICER AND TO TAKE ANY ACTION AS NECESSARY. 
Commissioner Ghio moved to CONVENE INTO EXECUTIVE SESSION TO INTERVIEW 
CANDIDATES FOR THE POSITION OF POLICE OFFICER, seconded by Council Member Tyler.       
 
Present in Executive Session: Commissioners Lemieux, Kilbourne, Sapp-Smith, Ghio, Council Member 
Tyler, Chief Morello, Deputy Chiefs Moskowitz and Osborne. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
No votes taken in Executive Session. 
 
 
3. TO RECONVENE INTO PUBLIC SESSION AND TO TAKE ANY ACTION AS 
NECESSARY.  
At 6:58 p.m., Commissioner Kilbourne moved to RECONVENE INTO PUBLIC SESSION, seconded 
by Council Member Tyler. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
 
 
Commissioner Ghio moved to REMOVE CANDIDATE #5 FROM THE LIST, seconded by 
Commissioner Kilbourne. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
 
 
Commissioner Ghio moved to OFFER CONDITIONAL EMPLOYMENT TO CANDIDATES # 6, 11, 
AND 14 UPON SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF ALL PRE-EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS, 
seconded by Commissioner Kilbourne. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED
4. ADJOURNMENT 
Council Member Tyler moved to ADJOURN, seconded by Commissioner Ghio. 
 
The regular meeting of the Board of Police Commissioners called for the 31st day of August, 2026, was 
HEREBY ADJOURNED AT 6:59 p.m. 
 
 
                   Lisa Ziogas                   Recording Secretary
